title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1973-09-21
lineage: Akai GX636 direct tape head output  > Bottlehead tube tape pre w/a pair of Telefunken tubes circa 1960  > Apogee Mini Me 24/96  > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering  > FLAC
source: most likely MR > R @3 & 3/4 ips - dub of Jerry's reel left at a girlfriends house done by Will Boswell was done back in the Spring of '79

ai_review.summary: High‑energy Spectrum show with a superb Truckin'>Other One>Wharf Rat sequence captured on a clean soundboard recording
ai_review.review: The September 21, 1973 Spectrum performance is praised for its fiery second‑set medley (Truckin' → The Other One → Wharf Rat) and the atmospheric Weather Report → Grow transition, with reviewers noting the band was in fine form despite the chilly night. The soundboard source delivers clear, balanced audio with no reported flaws, making this a highly enjoyable listen.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers give 4‑5 stars and highlight strong playing and set flow; the soundboard recording is described as clean with no issues, leading to a high combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Soundboard source noted as clear and well‑balanced; reviewers mention no audio problems or dropouts.

standout_songs: Truckin' > The Other One > Wharf Rat
Weather Report > Grow (with return to Wharf Rat intro/outro)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Set order correctly identified after correction; the second set flows smoothly with strong transitions and a satisfying encore.
